add.doc: Add a new internationalisation key with translations for all supported languages. The key_code is normalised before insertion: server category keys are lowercased and prefixed with underscore if missing, all other category keys are uppercased. Inserts one row per supported language via stored procedure intl_add_next, then returns the full newly created entry.

values.description: Object containing the key_code and translation strings keyed by language code (e.g. en, fr, vi). The key_code field is required inside the object and will be normalised based on the category.

category.description: Locale category to add the key under. Must be one of: ui, server, transfer, electron-web, electron-main, liceman, sandbox.

returns.description: Array of locale entry objects for the newly added key across all supported languages, returned by stored procedure intl_get_next

key_code.description: Normalised key code as stored (lowercased and underscore-prefixed for server category, uppercased for others)

lng.description: Language code for this row (e.g. en, fr, vi)

errors.message: values parameter is required but was not provided
category parameter is required but was not provided
Failed to insert locale entries via stored procedure intl_add_next

build.doc: Rebuild all locale JSON files on the filesystem from the database. Iterates over all application types (ui, server, transfer, electron-web, electron-main, liceman, sandbox) and all supported languages, calling stored procedure get_locale_next for each combination, then writes the result to static_dir/locale/TYPE/LANG.json. Also writes the file format registry to static_dir/dataset/files-formats.json. This operation overwrites existing locale files.

returns.description: Map of application type names to the directory path where their locale files were written, plus a mimetype field pointing to the files-formats.json output path

ui.description: Directory path where ui locale files were written

server.description: Directory path where server locale files were written

transfer.description: Directory path where transfer locale files were written

mimetype.description: File path where the files-formats.json registry was written

errors.message: Failed to fetch locale data or write locale files to filesystem

delete.doc: Delete an internationalisation key and all its language entries from the database. Calls stored procedure intl_delete_next with the key and type. Returns the deleted key code.

key.description: The key_code of the locale entry to delete (e.g. SAVE_BUTTON or _error_not_found)

type.description: Locale category to delete from. Defaults to "ui" if not provided.

returns.description: Confirmation object containing the deleted key code

key_code.description: The key_code that was deleted, echoed from the input key parameter

errors.message: key parameter is required but was not provided
Failed to delete locale entry via stored procedure intl_delete_next

keys.doc: List available internationalisation key codes matching an optional filter string and category. Calls stored procedure intl_keys_next. Returns a flat list of matching key records.

key.description: Partial key string to filter results. Defaults to empty string (returns all keys) if not provided.

category.description: Locale category to filter by. Defaults to "ui" if not provided.

returns.description: Array of locale key records matching the filter, returned by stored procedure intl_keys_next

errors.message: Failed to query locale keys via stored procedure intl_keys_next

get.doc: Retrieve a single internationalisation entry by key code and type. Calls stored procedure intl_get_next. The type parameter falls back to the category parameter if type is not provided.

key.description: The key_code to retrieve. Defaults to empty string if not provided.

type.description: Locale category to look up. Falls back to the category parameter if not provided. Defaults to "ui" if neither is set.

category.description: Alternative to type. Used as fallback when type is not provided. Defaults to "ui".

returns.description: Locale entry object for the requested key and type returned by stored procedure intl_get_next

des.description: Translation string for this key and language

errors.message: Failed to query locale entry via stored procedure intl_get_next

group.doc: Retrieve all internationalisation entries belonging to a named group. Calls stored procedure intl_get_by_group using a synchronous callback pattern. Returns grouped locale data for the specified group name.

name.description: The group name to retrieve locale entries for. Used directly as the key argument to stored procedure intl_get_by_group.

returns.description: Grouped locale data for the requested group name, returned by stored procedure intl_get_by_group

key_code.description: Locale key code within the group

category.description: Category of the locale entries in this group

errors.message: name parameter is required but was not provided
Failed to query locale group via stored procedure intl_get_by_group

list.doc: List internationalisation entries for a given category with pagination. Calls stored procedure intl_list_next and groups results by key_code so each returned object contains all language translations for that key.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

category.description: Locale category to list. Defaults to "ui" if not provided.

returns.description: Array of grouped locale objects, one per key_code, each containing the key code and nested per-language translation objects

key_code.description: The locale key code shared across all language entries

errors.message: Failed to query locale list via stored procedure intl_list_next

search.doc: Search internationalisation entries by value string and category with pagination. Calls stored procedure intl_search_next and groups results by key_code, returning one object per matching key containing all language translations.

value.description: Search string to match against translation values. Defaults to empty string (matches all) if not provided.

category.description: Locale category to search within. Defaults to "ui" if not provided.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

returns.description: Array of grouped locale objects matching the search query, one per key_code, each containing the key code and nested per-language translation objects

key_code.description: The locale key code matching the search query

errors.message: Failed to query locale search via stored procedure intl_search_next

update.doc: Update an internationalisation entry value. When id is provided, updates the entry directly by ID via stored procedure intl_update_by_id_next. When id is not provided, first creates the entry via intl_add_next using category, lang, and code, then updates it. Returns the entry context with previous, current, and next sibling records for navigation.

value.description: New translation string to set for the locale entry

id.description: ID of the existing locale entry to update. If not provided, a new entry is created first using category, lang, and code.

category.description: Locale category. Required when id is not provided in order to create the entry before updating.

lang.description: Language code (e.g. en, fr, vi). Required when id is not provided.

code.description: Key code for the new entry. Required when id is not provided.

returns.description: Contextual navigation object containing the updated entry and its adjacent sibling entries in the dataset

previous.description: The locale entry immediately before the updated entry in the ordered dataset

current.description: The updated locale entry in its new state

next.description: The locale entry immediately after the updated entry in the ordered dataset

errors.message: value parameter is required but was not provided
category is required when id is not provided
lang is required when id is not provided
code is required when id is not provided
Failed to update locale entry via stored procedure intl_update_by_id_next
